question: The ratio of the ages of two friends is 7 : 9, while after 10 years it will be 19 : 23. What will be their average age 7 years from now?
solution:
**Given:**

Present age ratio = 7 : 9

After 10 years their age ratio = 19 : 23

**Calculations:**

Let their ages be 7x and 9y.

Then according to question after 10 years the ratio of their ages will be

⇒ (7x + 10)/(9x + 10)= 19/23
